_comment: PROG-1027 progress side-channel limits. Single flag source: enabled (ships false). Env VERA_PROGRESS_DISABLED=1 forces off (kill switch, read by API and UI).
_calibration: PROVISIONAL / UNCALIBRATED (plan s3c, DV-PROG-1). No live data yet; review by 2026-11-10. max_records 64: occupancy = Ask arrivals x ttl_s; under public caps at most 180/day per shared client (OD-1031-PROMPTLIM), so 64 leaves margin; oldest closed record is evicted first. max_events_per_record 64: about 10 stages x 2 providers + ACQUIRE updates (inline budget up to 31, OD-1031-CEIL31) is about 51, doubled is about 102, so 128 (a buffer size, not a limit; was 64 for budget 2); the terminal event is always kept. ttl_s 600 >= UI backstop (ASK_TIMEOUT_S + poll_margin_s) plus render margin. poll_interval_s 1.0: spike showed 1 s keeps reruns responsive. poll_margin_s 5: UI backstop = ASK_TIMEOUT_S + margin. first_event_grace_s 10: 404 within this grace keeps the Sending label. get_timeout_s 2 <= 2 x poll_interval_s. max_count 10000: far above any real count. Data that would change them: store-full count > 0, max events seen in smoke, observed POST-to-RECEIVED and GET latency, owner smoke feel.
_note: OWNER DECISION PENDING (PROGE-1028 review): PROG-E keeps progress state in-process (STORE/DROPS), which conflicts with the owner 10-28 rule that all runtime/dynamic state lives in the DB. Keep enabled=false until the owner either accepts a recorded divergence or approves a DB table (DDL owner-gated). It also relies on a single uvicorn worker.

_calibration.enabled: OD-1031-STREAM-ON: ships true (owner decision, not measured). Kill switch VERA_PROGRESS_DISABLED=1 forces off. Polling 'enabled' stays false.
_calibration.heartbeat_s: PROVISIONAL prior 10, unmeasured (PLAN s2.3). Keeps bytes flowing well inside any idle window; Render idle behaviour undocumented, W10 measures it. Change from W10 gap/close data.
_calibration.client_no_data_s: PROVISIONAL prior 60 = 6 x heartbeat: connection lost after >=5 missed heartbeats. Unmeasured. Change from heartbeat-gap p99 in W10 and live.
_calibration.connect_timeout_s: PROVISIONAL liveness prior 10, unmeasured; change from observed connect latency. No total timeout exists on the stream (OD-1031-NODEADLINE).
_calibration.orphan_s: PROVISIONAL prior 120 = Streamlit disconnectedSessionTTL default (RENDER-TIMEOUT-1031); unmeasured. Change if the deployed TTL differs.
